description: Turn a corporate FX or payment requirement into a PaymentIntent: the currencies, the amount and whether it is what leaves or what must land, the value date, and the principal's own constraints. Accepts a sentence ('pay a Japanese supplier JPY 800m by 15 October') with the source currency, a flat form, or a full intent. The source currency is never assumed. Returns the intent, its hash and every assumption made. Free.

allowed_rail_classes.description: Optional. Only these rail classes may carry the payment: bank, specialist_fx, payout_network, payment_network, local_rail, stablecoin. Default: all.

amount_basis.description: Whether the amount leaves (source) or must land (destination). Default destination.

from.description: ISO 4217 code the money leaves in.

max_all_in_bps.description: The principal's own limit on all-in cost against the reference, in basis points.

max_settlement_days.description: The principal's own limit on settlement time.

payer.description: Who is paying, so onboarding_status can be resolved per candidate instead of defaulting to onboardable-with-steps. All optional.

has_local_bank_account.description: Whether the payer holds a bank account in the destination country.

onboarded_providers.description: Provider ids the payer is already onboarded with (marks that candidate ready).

registration_country.description: ISO 3166 country the paying entity is registered in.

to.description: ISO 4217 code it must land in.

value_date.description: ISO date the money must land by.

name: compile_intent
title: Structure a payment intent
